d: We are seeking an experienced and proactive HR Manager to oversee the full spectrum of human resources operations in Dubai. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing HR strategies, managing local HR operations, driving talent development, ensuring regulatory compliance and supporting business growth.

This role requires strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international stakeholders, regional teams and senior management across different markets.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of relevant HR experience, including at least 2 years in a managerial role.
Previous HR management experience in Dubai or the UAE is highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of UAE labour laws, employment regulations and local HR practices.
Solid experience in managing the full spectrum of HR functions.
Demonstrated experience in designing, delivering and evaluating employee training and development programmes.
Proven experience working with international stakeholders within a multinational or multicultural environment.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently, coordinate across different time zones and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Strong problem-solving, decision-making and organisational skills.
Excellent command of written and spoken English. Mandarin proficiency is an added advantage.
Professional HR certifications such as CIPD, SHRM or equivalent are an added advantage.
Experience in fintech, financial services, technology or multinational companies is preferred.
Candidates currently based in Dubai or willing to relocate are welcome to apply.

d: At Namaa, we build and operate tech-enabled urban infrastructure that gives consumers fast, reliable access to meals, groceries, and everyday essentials.

Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today’s digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.

We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That’s why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.

Our ecosystem is driven by a portfolio of specialized business units, including KitchenPark, CloudRetail, and Profood Properties, each playing a key role in enabling brands to grow and thrive in an increasingly on-demand world.
